ClassMembers.name: Logger
ClassMembers.summary: Static class used for thread-safe logging. Writes timestamped log entries into per-day log files under the application Log directory.

ClassMembers.name: SafeExecutor
ClassMembers.summary: Static utility class responsible for safely executing synchronous and asynchronous actions with standardized error handling.

ClassMembers.name: IConnectionFactory
ClassMembers.summary: Interface for defining a factory class for a specific database connection creation.

ClassMembers.name: SqlServerConnectionFactory
ClassMembers.summary: Factory class for creating and initializing connections to the SQL Server database using configuration settings.

ClassMembers.name: IDBEntity
ClassMembers.summary: Interface defining the base for database entities, ensuring they possess a unique identifier.

ClassMembers.name: Account
ClassMembers.summary: Represents a bank account entity stored in the database. Contains account number, balance, status, creation date, and optional closure date.

ClassMembers.name: DAOBase
ClassMembers.summary: Abstract base class for Data Access Objects. Provides a common structure and helper methods for database operations on entities.

ClassMembers.name: AccountDAO
ClassMembers.summary: Data Access Object for bank accounts. Provides methods to create accounts, deposit, withdraw, retrieve balances, remove accounts, and get bank-wide totals using SQL Server stored procedures and views.

ClassMembers.name: Server
ClassMembers.summary: Represents the TCP server for the bank application. Listens for incoming client connections, creates ClientSession instances, and handles start/stop operations with proper logging and cancellation support.

ClassMembers.name: NetworkConfig
ClassMembers.summary: Static class providing network configuration settings for the bank P2P network. Retrieves port range and network prefix from application configuration.

ClassMembers.name: IPAddressObtainer
ClassMembers.summary: Static utility class to obtain the local machine's IPv4 address. Returns the first available IPv4 address or null if none are found.

ClassMembers.name: ClientSession
ClassMembers.summary: Represents a network session with a connected client. Receives and processes commands asynchronously using CommandHandler, handles timeouts, and logs all session activity.

ClassMembers.name: BankNetworkExplorer
ClassMembers.summary: Static utility class to discover other banks in the P2P network. Provides methods to generate IP addresses of potential bank nodes and structure their info.

ClassMembers.name: BankProxyClient
ClassMembers.summary: Static class responsible for forwarding commands to other bank nodes in the P2P network. Scans a range of TCP ports, establishes connections, and safely sends/receives commands with timeouts.

ClassMembers.name: CommandHandler
ClassMembers.summary: Handles processing of banking commands. Maps command keys to ICommand implementations and executes them, using AccountDAO to interact with accounts stored in the database.

ClassMembers.name: AccountBalanceCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to retrieve the balance of a specific account. Uses AccountDAO for local accounts or forwards the request to another bank node in the network.

ClassMembers.name: AccountCreateCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to create a new account in the database. Uses AccountDAO to generate the account and returns the new account number with the local IP.

ClassMembers.name: AccountDepositCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to deposit a specified amount into an account. Uses AccountDAO for local accounts or forwards the deposit request to another bank node in the network.

ClassMembers.name: AccountRemoveCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to remove an account from the database. Uses AccountDAO and only allows removal of local accounts based on the local IP.

ClassMembers.name: AccountWithdrawCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to withdraw a specified amount from an account. Uses AccountDAO for local accounts or forwards the withdrawal request to another bank node in the network.

ClassMembers.name: BankAmountCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to retrieve the total amount of money held by the bank. Uses AccountDAO to calculate the sum of all account balances.

ClassMembers.name: BankClientCountCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to retrieve the total number of clients in the bank. Uses AccountDAO to count all accounts stored in the database.

ClassMembers.name: BankCodeCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to retrieve the local IPv4 address of the bank node. Returns the address as the bank code and takes no arguments.

ClassMembers.name: RobberyPlanCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Command to compute a robbery plan across the bank P2P network. Discovers other banks, gathers their total funds and client counts, and selects a subset of banks to reach a target amount within a time limit.

ClassMembers.name: IAccountInteractionCommand
ClassMembers.summary: Interface for commands that interact with bank accounts.

ClassMembers.name: ICommand
ClassMembers.summary: Interface representing a bank command. Each command has a unique Key and can be executed with a string of arguments.
